    StartersBayou hush puppies with Cajun remouladeSpicy Cajun mayo dip. Captain Insano shows no mercy.How to make it200g fine cornmeal100g plain flour2 tsp baking powder1 tsp salt1/4 tsp cayenne pepper1 egg250ml buttermilk3 spring onions, sliced1 L vegetable oil, for frying150g mayonnaise1 tbsp wholegrain mustard1 tbsp chopped dill pickles1 tsp Cajun seasoning1/2 lemon, juicedMix the cornmeal, flour, baking powder, salt and cayenne. Whisk in the egg and buttermilk, then fold in the spring onions.Rest the batter.Stir together the mayonnaise, mustard, pickles, Cajun seasoning and lemon juice for the remoulade.Heat the oil to 180°C and drop in heaped teaspoons of batter. Fry, turning, until deep golden, working in batches.Drain on paper towel and serve hot with the remoulade.Bourbon Bowl Cajun butter prawnsCajun spiced prawns swirled in garlic butter, with baguetteHow to make it800g green prawns2 tsp Cajun seasoning1 tbsp vegetable oil60g butter3 garlic cloves, crushed1 lemon1 small bunch parsley1 baguette, slicedPeel and devein the prawns, leaving the tails on, and toss with the Cajun seasoning.Sear the prawns in a very hot pan with oil in a single layer, turning once.Drop the heat, add the butter and garlic and swirl until foaming.Squeeze over the lemon, scatter with parsley and serve from the pan with the baguette.MainsMama Boucher's chicken and sausage gumboMama's right! Dark roux gumbo, chicken, smoked sausage, okra, rice.How to make it80g plain flour80ml vegetable oil1 onion, diced2 celery sticks, diced1 green capsicum, diced600g chicken thigh fillets, diced300g smoked sausage, sliced2 tsp Cajun seasoning1.2 L chicken stock200g okra, sliced300g long grain rice2 spring onions, slicedhot sauce, to serveStir the flour into the oil in a heavy pot over medium-low heat until the roux turns dark brown like chocolate.Add the onion, celery and capsicum and cook until soft.Add the chicken, sausage, Cajun seasoning and stock. Simmer.Add the okra and cook until tender. Meanwhile steam the rice.Serve over rice with spring onion and hot sauce.Vicki Vallencourt's blackened catfish po' boysVicki's just out of jail, she knows a good sandwichHow to make it700g basa or catfish fillets2 tbsp Cajun seasoning40g butter4 long soft rolls1/4 iceberg lettuce, shredded2 tomatoes, sliced8 dill pickle slices4 tbsp whole egg mayonnaise1 tbsp wholegrain mustard1 tsp hot sauce1 lemonMix the mayonnaise, mustard, hot sauce and a squeeze of lemon for the remoulade.Coat the fish in the Cajun seasoning.Melt the butter in a very hot pan and cook the fish until blackened and just cooked.Split the rolls, spread with remoulade and fill with lettuce, tomato, pickles and fish.SweetsBourbon Bowl pecan pralinesCreamy brown sugar pecan pralines spooned out to setHow to make it200g pecans200g brown sugar100g caster sugar120ml thickened cream40g butter1 tsp vanilla extractToast the pecans in a dry pan.Combine the sugars, cream and butter in a heavy saucepan and stir over medium heat until boiling.Cook without stirring to 115°C on a sugar thermometer.Off the heat, add the vanilla and pecans and beat with a wooden spoon until thick and cloudy.Quickly spoon rounds onto baking paper and leave to set.DrinksBobby Boucher's cucumber lime coolerCucumber, lime, mint and honey in sparkling water. H2O, not Gatorade.How to make it3 tbsp honey1 Lebanese cucumber4 limes, juiced, plus extra for wheels1 small bunch mint1 L sparkling water, chilled1 bag crushed iceStir the honey into hot water until dissolved, then cool.Peel the cucumber into thin ribbons.Muddle the lime juice, mint and honey syrup in a jug.Fill glasses with ice and cucumber, add the sparkling water to the jug, stir gently and pour over. Garnish with lime wheels and mint.
